title: The Commercial street near the port
subtitle: 经济消费 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）
meta: 主题语境：经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）　|　核心词汇：commercial　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 commercial 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1950 the engineer wrote of ① a commercial street near the port in the manual, and everybody in the workshop said at once that it was ② more commercial than the one named there the year before. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the engineer, who never explained anything, had done it year after year and gone home; it was the commercial ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most commercial street near the port anybody in the workshop had ever seen, or so the manual for April 1944 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too commercial to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the worker who had come to help; the commercial ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the lever at the far bench, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a commercial deal over the shop, and said that no worker in his right mind would call it ⑥ as commercial as the deal over the shop they had once had in the old workshop. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was commercial or not, and he said so.

By 1957 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the manual. What the line asked for was ⑦ something commercial, and nothing besides. The worker from the next workshop called the whole plan ⑧ quite commercial; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the manual kept the names of the commercial ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1960, for the whole place, she wrote of another commercial street near the port in the same manual, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ more commercial than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most commercial deal over the shop in the whole workshop, she said in 1962, was the one she could never quite name; the commercial ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 商业（前置定语 a commercial street near the port：1950 年工程师在说明书里记下的那件商业的大街）
B. adj. 商业／营利（比较级 more commercial than：文中两处，一处比港口旁的大街，一处比预想）
C. adj. 商业／营利（最高级 the most commercial：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 商业（表语 too commercial to do：母亲觉得它太商业，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 营利（前置定语 a commercial deal over the shop：叔叔把整件事称作一桩营利的买卖）
F. adj. 营利（同级比较 as commercial as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩店铺的买卖相比）
G. adj. 营利（后置定语 something commercial：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 营利（受程度副词修饰 quite commercial：那位工人的评价）

items.q: a commercial street near the port
the most commercial street near the port anybody
a commercial deal over the shop
The most commercial deal over the shop in

answers.why: commercial 意为“商业”，1950 年工程师在说明书里记下的是“一件商业的大街”，此处作前置定语 a commercial street near the port。
commercial 意为“商业”，此处用比较级 more commercial than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
commercial 意为“商业”，说明书上 四月 那行字说它是车间里最商业的一件，故用最高级 the most commercial street near the port。
commercial 意为“商业”，母亲认为这件东西“太商业了，谁也用不上”，too commercial to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
commercial 意为“营利”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩营利的买卖”，此处作前置定语 a commercial deal over the shop。
commercial 意为“营利”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩店铺的买卖一样营利”，同级比较用 as commercial as。
commercial 意为“营利”，说明书上那半行字要的是“营利的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something commercial。
commercial 意为“营利”，邻车间来的那位工人认为这套计划“相当营利”，quite 修饰原级 commercial。
commercial 意为“营利”，1960 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要营利”，故用比较级 more commercial than。
commercial 意为“营利”，母亲 1962 年说的是“整个车间里最营利的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most commercial deal over the shop。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1950 年，工程师在说明书里记下了一件商业的大街。（a commercial street near the port）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更商业。（more commercial than …）
母亲觉得它太商业，谁也用不上。（too commercial to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩营利的买卖。（a commercial deal over the shop）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩店铺的买卖一样营利。（as commercial as …）
到了 1957 年，说明书上只剩半行字：要的是一件营利的东西。（something commercial）
answers: In 1950 the engineer wrote of a commercial street near the port in the manual.
Everybody said it was more commercial than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too commercial to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a commercial deal over the shop.
He said nobody would call it as commercial as the deal over the shop they had once had.
By 1957 the manual asked for nothing but something commercial.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 commercial 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1950 the engineer wrote of a commercial street near the port in the manual, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most commercial street near the port in the workshop, or so the manual says.
My mother thought it too commercial to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a commercial deal over the shop, and nobody argued with him.
The worker from the next workshop called the plan quite commercial, and everybody laughed.
The commercial ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
